title: [BUG] Sync word 0x34 defined but never programmed onto any radio (spec 02 sec 3.2)
description: Req R-02-006 (spec 02-physical-link.md 3.2): Sync Word default 0x34, distinct from Meshtastic 0x2B. DIVERGENT: constant exists but no driver uses it. Evidence: rust/lichen-core/src/constants.rs:4 LORA_SYNC_WORD=0x34 has zero callers; C lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2.c:299-303 sets no sync word and leaves Zephyr public_network=false (Semtech private sync byte, not 0x34); python radio/phy_params.py:30 is config-only. All 0x34 assertions live in the LCI /config/radio CBOR store (rust/lichen-client/src/radio_config.rs, lichen/tests/coap_config/main.c:328, test/vectors/lci_radio_config.json) — config surface, not radio programming. Interop-critical: impls may not share a sync word on hardware. Suggested placement: C lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2.c modem config (+ lr1110 driver sync API if needed); rust lichen-embassy radio setup; add a test asserting the programmed value.
close_reason: RE-CLOSE (store write lost — bd8h). Completed and committed as f181d813fa on beads-worker-7: lr1110.c lora_config() sets LR1110_RADIO_LORA_NETWORK_PUBLIC (Semtech public byte = 0x34 per R-02-006) unconditionally; lora_l2.c sets .public_network=true. Verified against the loramac-node lr1110_driver SetLoRaSyncWord semantics. See prior close.
